frontmatter.title: Money Can't Buy What a Job Takes
frontmatter.description: Three years of weekends, holidays and headspace went into one company. In my notice period I watched all of it go back to zero. A note for anyone early in their career about what a job keeps, what it takes, and what to keep for yourself.

frontmatter.title: Three Rounds
frontmatter.description: A year into boxing, a note on what it feels like when a sport gets hold of you. For anyone who boxes, and anyone curious about why people do.
